request.prompt:
Single retro JRPG hero battle sprite on a 100% solid flat magenta background (#FF00FF). Dragon Quest inspired more than Final Fantasy, but original design.

Character:
- young heroic warrior
- blue tunic, small cape, leather boots
- sword and round shield
- confident but simple classic JRPG silhouette

Style:
- clean 16-bit pixel art
- full body
- readable at game scale
- centered with generous magenta margin
- no background scene
- background is ONLY solid flat magenta (#FF00FF)
- no text, no UI, no frame

Pose:
- battle-ready idle pose
- facing slightly right
- suitable for a starter selection and battle loop showcase
